apps.name: VoiceMatrix Experimental
apps.localizedDescription: Fully bundled offline speech and voice conversion. 537 conditioning profiles with automated English audio checks, searchable categories and vocal-depth filters. Conversion supports recordings up to 10 seconds. Physical per-profile listening and character resemblance remain unverified. Some reference-derived voices are noncommercial only.

versions.localizedDescription: 537 bundled profiles. Real offline neural conversion and speech; automated simulator audio checks, no near-indistinguishable claim.
